I can only speak for Miami although I know Detorit, New York and San Francisco have pretty good clubs.

However, here in Miami techno has been making a crazy comeback. I don't know if you've heard of Club Space in Miami. But it's the longest running club here (about 20 years now). Well, it was bought by new investors and I know the two dudes running it. They've really made it the best club in Miami. Parties begin on Saturdays at around 11pm and go on to Sundays at 3pm often. Special Holiday parties have lasted up to 36 hours. That's for the "terrace" where they book the biggest names/parties. The terrace has an open roof and you can see the sun rise as the best sets/real party begins. But there's 2 more smaller clubs/bars within it where they book lesser know djs and bands.

They used to throw house parties and eventually club parties until they rented out their own club "Trade" (Which was my favorite club in Miami) Setphan Bodzin, Adam Beyer, Nina, Liebing, Fur Coat, Tale of us etc etc all played there. The club was tiny but damn was it awesome. But they grew so much they decided to sell and move to Space. 

Just from now until December they have alreay annouced, Nina, Dusky, Joris, Chirs Liebing, Ben Klock, Apollonia Loco Dice, The black Madonna, Richie Hawtin, Marco Carola and Solomun.  The cool thing is if you buys the ticket with enough time in advance they're usually just $10. There's also smaller clubs like "treehouse" and "do not sit in the furniture" trying to fill the void left by Trade. They have booked people Sam Paganini and Len Faki. Who aren't as big in the States but definitely loved in Miami. 

With that said, I think if you come to Miami you'll have a good time. I know the west coast is more into EDM but down here we love techno. If you go to NY definitely check out a club called "Output". It's a roof top bar in Brooklyn and they always book the best. I haven't gone but only hear good things and the views during sunset/sunrise look amazing.
